article.headline: Binet scores 16, Alcorn State earns 1st win of the season, beats Alabama A&M 62-52
article.description: — Djahi Binet scored 16 points as Alcorn State earned its first win of the season to snap a string of 14 straight losses, beating Alabama A&M 62-52 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Binet scores 16, Alcorn State earns 1st win of the season, beats Alabama A&M 62-52
article.story: LORMAN, Miss. -- — Djahi Binet scored 16 points as Alcorn State earned its first win of the season to snap a string of 14 straight losses, beating Alabama A&M 62-52 on Saturday night. Binet had nine rebounds for the Braves (1-14, 1-1 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Marcus Tankersley scored 14 points, going 5 of 11 and 4 of 6 from the free-throw line. Julian Lual had nine points and went 4 of 12 from the field (1 for 6 from 3-point range). The Braves snapped a 14-game skid. Saliou Seye led the way for the Bulldogs (6-10, 2-1) with 12 points. Anthony Bryant added 11 points for Alabama A&M. Chad Moodie had eight points, 10 rebounds and four blocks. Both teams next play Monday. Alcorn State hosts Alabama State and Alabama A&Msquares off against Jackson State on the road. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
